title: Donate
description: Donate to Hijaz Hospital Trust — Zakat, Sadaqah, general donations, and support programs for deserving patients.

hero.title: Donate to Hijaz Hospital Trust
hero.quote: "Whoever saves one life, it is as if he has saved all mankind." (Qur'an 5:32)
hero.excerpt: Every act of giving helps save lives. Whether you choose to give Zakat, Sadaqah, General Donation, Eidi, or Fitrana, your generosity enables Hijaz Hospital Trust to provide quality healthcare to deserving patients who cannot afford treatment. Explore the different ways you can support our mission and make a lasting impact.

givingTypes.title: Zakat
givingTypes.excerpt: Let Your Zakat Become a Source of Healing. Zakat is a sacred obligation and an opportunity to bring hope to those in need.

givingTypes.title: General Donation
givingTypes.excerpt: Every Donation Makes a Difference. Your generosity helps Hijaz Hospital Trust provide quality healthcare to patients who cannot afford the cost of treatment.

givingTypes.title: Sadaqah
givingTypes.excerpt: Turn Your Sadaqah into Healing and Hope. Beyond Zakat, Sadaqah reflects gratitude, kindness, and compassion.

givingTypes.title: Eidi & Fitrana
givingTypes.excerpt: Share the Blessings of Eid. Eid is a time of joy, gratitude, and compassion.

supportCauses.title: Donate a Meal
supportCauses.excerpt: Nourish a Patient. Support Their Recovery. Through our Donate a Meal initiative, you can help provide meals to deserving patients.

supportCauses.title: Donate in Kind
supportCauses.excerpt: Support Patient Care Through Essential Supplies. Medicines, equipment, hospital beds, wheelchairs, and more.

supportCauses.title: Sponsor a Patient
supportCauses.excerpt: Become a Source of Healing and Hope. Sponsor hepatitis treatment, dialysis care, gynae & maternity care, or medical treatment based on patient need.

supportCauses.title: Sponsor Free Surgeries
supportCauses.excerpt: Support Life-Changing Surgical Care. General surgery, urology, eye surgery, and specialized procedures.

supportCauses.title: Support a Project — ITW Medical Tower
supportCauses.excerpt: Help Build the Future of Healthcare. Construction of new patient wards, ICU development, and facility expansion.

waysToGive.heading: Choose Your Donation Method
waysToGive.lede: Supporting Hijaz Hospital Trust is simple, secure, and impactful. Your contribution helps us provide quality healthcare to deserving patients and strengthens our mission of serving humanity with compassion and dignity. Choose the donation method that is most convenient for you.

online.heading: Donate securely via JazzCash
online.body: Donate securely through our online payment gateway using your debit or credit card. All online donations are processed through a secure platform, and a confirmation receipt will be provided.

jazzcash.heading: JazzCash Till
jazzcash.body: Donate quickly and conveniently through mobile payment services.
jazzcash.qrNote: QR Code · add JazzCash QR in Admin (donationMethods)

otherWays.title: Cheque or Bank Draft
otherWays.body: Donations may also be made through cheque or bank draft payable to: Hijaz Social Welfare Society (Hijaz Hospital). Address: 27-D-1, Sir Syed Road, Gulberg III, Lahore Pakistan

otherWays.title: Pick-Up Donation Service
otherWays.body: For your convenience, our authorized representatives can collect donations from your home or office.

otherWays.title: Meezan Mobile App
otherWays.body: Hijaz Hospital is available as a trusted donation recipient on the Meezan Mobile App, offering donors a secure, convenient, and Shariah-compliant way to support our healthcare services.

otherWays.title: QR Code Donation
otherWays.body: Scan the QR code using your banking or mobile wallet application to make a secure donation in just a few simple steps.

receiptsNote: Official donation receipts are issued for all contributions. Please share your payment details with our Donations Office to receive your acknowledgement and receipt.

zakatCalculator.heading: Calculate Your Zakat
zakatCalculator.body: Use our Zakat Calculator to calculate your Zakat before making your donation.
